title: Leonida Trophy Guide
note: Names, descriptions, grades and hidden flags follow the official PlayStation 5 list as published by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 18 November 2026. Guides are written in our own words from those descriptions and the cited guides. Trophies marked confirmed:false have an unlock method no two guides have yet pinned down, so the guide says so instead of guessing.

sources.name: PSNProfiles — Grand Theft Auto VI trophies
KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours, so there is nothing to do for this one directly. Work the roadmap in order: finish the story, then the stranger strands and activities, then the 100% checklist cleanup. Expect roughly 200 hours all in, per PowerPyx.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play Jason's opening mission Gone Fishing to the end and it pops at the mission-complete screen. Nothing to prepare and nothing to clean up later.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and it unlocks with the chapter wrap-up. Just keep playing the story in order.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete Chapter 2's final mission and the trophy follows. No side content is needed for it.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play through Chapter 3 to its end. The chapter trophies stack up on their own while you follow the story.

trophies.name: Top of the World, Ma
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 4 and it pops. By now the pattern is clear: every chapter end carries one of these, so none of them can be missed.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable, and the big one for stage 1. Beat the final story mission and the gold is yours. After the credits you can keep exploring Leonida freely, which is when the real platinum work starts.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Breakfast Run is a main-story mission; finish it and the trophy unlocks. If you are following the story in order you cannot pass it by.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. The Cartel Heist is a main-story heist mission; complete it and this pops. Heist prep is part of the story flow, so just play through.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Child's Play is a story mission; finishing it earns the trophy. No extra objective is attached.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Headliners is a main-story mission; complete it and the trophy follows at the results screen.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. VCIA Takedown is a story mission at the airport; finish it and this unlocks. Expect a heavy shootout, but the trophy itself asks nothing extra.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Operation Savage Glory is a main-story mission; complete it and the trophy pops. It is the last of the named story-mission trophies.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the last gold most hunters earn. The 100% checklist opens after the story (Touch Pad, then Progress, then 100% Completion). You do not need literally everything: PowerPyx notes it is roughly 60% of true completion, for example 15 of the 18 collectible card sets and 70 of the 80 challenges. Work the checklist line by line after the credits and this lands before the final cleanup.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in Leonida: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps. Mix the easy ones first — stunt jumps off ramps are the fastest to rack up — and track them under Touch Pad, Progress, Activities, Stunts. You only need a little over half the total, so skip the ones that fight you.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all 9 activity types at least once each. Open Touch Pad, Activities to see the list, then sample one of each — a race, a drone race, fishing, the shooting range, an arcade game, and so on. One quick try each is enough; you do not need to win or finish anything.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Most challenges have three difficulty tiers, and some stay locked until you meet their conditions, which the map shows. Bring your best aim, repeat the tight ones, and check progress under Touch Pad, Activities, Shooting Ranges.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Some charge an entry fee, so keep some cash handy. Find them under Touch Pad, Activities, Drones, Top Fun Drones. Learn each course's corners on a practice run, then race to win — only wins count.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — repeats of the same race do not count. Race locations are all over the map; track them under Touch Pad, Activities, Racing. Most let you hire a car, and your own car's Rating matters, so upgrade at Mod Shops if you bring your own ride.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Early in the game Cal asks you to catch a parrotfish over 2kg. Take a boat with a fishing rod to the marked area and fish until you land one big enough. Any boat works, and there are plenty to borrow nearby if you do not own one yet.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Walk up to any arcade cabinet and finish one full game. It does not matter which cabinet or whether you set a high score — completing the game is what counts. Arcades are marked on the map once you have found one.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's whole stranger strand, ending with his final mission Puff Puff Pass. Stranger missions appear as you explore, so answer Andy's calls and follow his marker until the strand closes. It also counts toward Strangers & Freaks.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger strand, ending with the mission Maritime Disputes. Work through his missions in order as they appear; the trophy pops when the last one is done.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger strand, ending with the mission Hometown Heroes. Follow Billy's markers through his missions until the strand closes and the trophy unlocks.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete any 8 of the 14 stranger mission strands. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each carry one, and more strangers appear as you explore. There is no need to finish all 14 — eight closed strands is the line, so pick the ones whose missions you enjoy.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger strand. His missions revolve around his vehicle wish list, so expect to track down specific cars around Leonida and bring them to him. The trophy pops when his last mission is complete.

trophies.name: Spin on This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger strand. His missions involve the Kitty Litter Lab, so follow his markers and finish each job in turn until the strand closes.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE missable trophy — the only one both PowerPyx and GTABase flag. Meditate at all 18 spots across Leonida, and do the first one while you still can: one spot sits at Jason's house in Chapter 1, and it may not be reachable later. A meditation only counts once the final zen animation has played, so stay put until it finishes. Track them under Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations, and check the map under Exploration, Meditate Around Leonida.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret sends you after a unique animal. Take the hunt slowly: approach from downwind, use a scoped rifle, and do not spook the animal into fleeing the area. One clean hunt for Bret is all it takes.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida; grab every one you pass while doing other things and the first sets fill up on their own. Track them under Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, Collectible Cards. Cards sold at pawn shops still count toward your progress, so selling is safe.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Open the WAiNK app on Jason's or Lucia's phone (hold Up) and scan 100 locations: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags. Scan everything you walk past — the count adds up fast during normal exploration. Check progress under Touch Pad, Progress, Collections, WAiNK Locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 in-game challenges. Challenges are skill goals listed under Touch Pad, Progress, Challenges — driving feats, combat feats, exploration feats. Pick the easy ones first and let the rest come naturally; 70 are needed for 100% completion, so this trophy falls on the way there.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Get out of the search area fast, break line of sight, and swap vehicles once you are clear of the flashing zone. The trophy pops once the wanted level fully clears with your partner still with you.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them. Plan a short route between three nearby shops, keep a fast getaway car parked outside each one, and move quickly — the chain breaks if your wanted level drops to zero before the third robbery.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. You discover one just by getting inside it or scanning it, so this mostly happens on its own during the story. To push it along, hop into every new car, bike, boat and plane you see. Track what you have found under Touch Pad, Progress, Vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies during one single use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies bunch together — a gang hideout or a police ambush — trigger Combat Focus, and work through five targets before it ends. A weapon with a fast fire rate helps; do not waste the window reloading.

trophies.name: Catch Me if You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Head to Vice City International Airport, get yourself a plane, and take off without following the usual script — an unscheduled departure, in the trophy's words. Expect airport security to object; a fast plane and a quick climb out are the whole plan.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description is a joke about the Rhino tank, so the unlock involves getting into a Rhino and making trouble with it. Steal one from a military area, survive the response it draws, and the trophy should follow once you have caused enough chaos in it.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean without ever being detected. Go in quiet: avoid cameras and sightlines, take what you need, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, walk away and try again — detection voids the attempt.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank jobs draw a heavy response, so plan the getaway before you go in: a fast car stashed nearby, a route away from the main roads, and no lingering to admire the loot. Each successful escape counts toward the five.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks run set routes around Leonida; stop one, crack it open, grab the cash, and lose the wanted level that follows. A sticky approach — block the road ahead, then hit it fast — beats chasing one down the highway.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every part of Leonida — Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the Keys and the countryside. The map fills in as you travel, so drive, fly and sail into the corners you have not visited yet. It pairs naturally with the collectible and WAiNK hunts in stage 3.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Each gang runs its own off-the-books spots; hit one per gang and the trophy pops. Scout them first — these are defended — and do not try to do them all in one run.

trophies.name: In the Beginning...
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists this trophy's exact unlock as not yet known, and no second guide has pinned it down. The description points at a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach, so a beachfront bar is the likely spot — but treat that as a lead, not a fact, until a guide confirms it.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists this trophy's exact unlock as not yet known. The description suggests driving a car out through a vehicle showroom's front window, in the style of the classic GTA openings — a strong hint, but no guide has confirmed the exact showroom or trigger yet.

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed: no guide has pinned down the exact trigger yet. The description points at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley, so the unlock likely involves a full game there — a strike, a full game, or a specific shot — but until a guide confirms it, head to the alley and bowl a full game.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed: the exact unlock is not yet known. The description hints at a partnership that wins over a crowd — likely a co-op activity with Lucia or Jason done well enough to impress. No guide has confirmed the activity or the score needed, so this one stays flagged until the guides catch up.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed: the exact unlock is not yet known. The description suggests a story choice with consequences — make a decision at one of the game's choice points and live with it. Which choice, and whether either branch counts, has not been confirmed by any guide yet.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists this trophy's exact unlock as not yet known. The description — second time's the charm — suggests succeeding at something on a retry after a first failure. Which activity counts is unconfirmed, so do not chase it blindly; it will likely pop on its own during the platinum run.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed: PowerPyx lists this trophy's exact unlock as not yet known. The description reads like a reaction to something strange — an easter egg or an odd event somewhere in Leonida. No guide has confirmed what triggers it, so this one is flagged and left open.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Unconfirmed: the precise method is still being confirmed. The description points at a melee drive-by that bowls people over — attacking from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. The exact target count or location is not confirmed, so treat the wording as the lead and check the cited guides for updates.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 in total by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; hand them to a contact who cleans them and the total climbs. Keep robbing and laundering through the post-story cleanup and the quarter-million arrives on its own.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. Clothes, weapons, car mods, food — everything you buy counts. PushSquare calls it the easiest trophy in the game, and it is: by the time you have bought garages, upgrades and gear for the platinum run, the $100,000 is long spent.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties through the Vice City Real Estate app on your phone, for $160,000 in total: Mitchel Auto Center $4,000, 7th Avenue Garage $12,000, Vela Rota Drive Garage $24,000, Persistence Road Garage $7,600, Wyatt Motors $21,600, Bonita Court Garage $34,000, Atlantic Court Garage $40,000 and Store n' Bolt $16,800. Each adds one parking spot for registered vehicles, so this also feeds On the Spot.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 different vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. Register any vehicle you are driving at a Pay 'N' Spray or Mod Shop, as long as you have a free parking spot — the fee varies with the vehicle's value. Buy garages first (Little Boxes) if you run out of spots; Scooter Bros then delivers your registered, fully repaired vehicles to you for a small fee.
